case.title: The operator has no record of this deposit address

provenance.status: Reproduced live on 2026-10-26. GET /v0/status with no X-API-Key returns HTTP 404 and the header X-RateLimit-Limit-unauth 1200, so the lookup runs unauthenticated. A deliberately wrong key returns 401 instead, which is why a rejected key falls back to no key.

status.reason: The operator has no record of this deposit address. Either the quote was never created, or the address belongs to a different route.

notes: The endpoint answered without a key, so read access is not the barrier here.
